selection_conditions.description: Top candidate per family after quality gates under the preregistered ensemble selector.
Lower-scoring candidate from the same family matched on visual quality, motion, colorfulness, and artifact score.

session_design.cover_task: brief non-memory judgment after each Session 1 video
session_design.recognition_task: two-alternative forced choice old-vs-lure with confidence and optional post-choice free-text recall

content_families.prompt_template: Natural realistic 5-second video of orange flowers with clear petals, gentle motion, stable composition, no people, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second video of hanging clothes or laundry moving gently, clear fabric detail, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second underwater video of blue jellyfish drifting slowly, clear central subject, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second video of an old car with distinctive shape and setting, gentle camera or environmental motion, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second aerial beach video with shoreline, water motion, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second city street video with buildings, street geometry, subtle motion, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second stormy beach video with waves, clouds, shoreline, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second video of butterflies near flowers with clear subjects, gentle motion, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second video of street food cooking on a grill with visible steam or flame motion, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second video of rain droplets moving on a window with a distinct background, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second video of hands shaping clay on a pottery wheel, clear action, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
Natural realistic 5-second video of a candle flame on a table with subtle flame motion, stable composition, no text, no watermark.
